column5: {"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Be warned that the server is currently serving a high number of users, consider using alternative game servers."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"The server is currently serving a high number of users, You cannot currently join. You may wait for the number of living crew to decline, observe, or find alternative servers."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"The server is currently serving a high number of users, find alternative servers."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Sorry but the server is currently not accepting connections from never before seen players."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Your version of byond may have issues or be blocked from accessing this server in the future."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Your version of byond is too old, may have issues, and is blocked from accessing this server."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"There are no admins currently on. Do not press the button below if your ahelp is a joke, a request or a question. Use it only for cases of obvious grief."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Toggles combat mode. Like Help/Harm but cooler."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Held down to cycle to the other move intent, release to cycle back"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Pressing this cycle to the opposite move intent, does not cycle back"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"The gas most life forms need to be able to survive. Also an oxidizer."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A very common gas that used to pad artificial atmospheres to habitable pressure."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A flammable gas with many curious properties. Its research is one of Nanotrasen\u0027s primary objectives."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Water, in gas form. Makes floors slippery and washes items on them."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"The most noble gas of them all. High quantities actively prevents reactions from occurring."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A gas known to causes drowsiness, euphoria, and eventually unconsciousness. Commonly used as an anesthetic for surgical procedures, and occasionally, as a recreational drug."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"An experimental (and slightly toxic) performance enhancing gas that increases speed and alertness when inhaled."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A powerful hallucinogenic nerve agent able to induce cognitive damage."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"An alternative to oxygen that is eight times more efficient at lung diffusion and even has minor healing properties - while itself not being an oxidizer."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Miasma is not necessarily a gas, but more broadly refers to biological pollutants found in the atmosphere known to cause disease and nausea."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A coolant gas. Primarily used for its endothermic reaction with oxygen."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"An experimental alternative to anesthetic that induces a state of unconsciousness that accelerates healing and regeneration when inhaled."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A volatile gas that has wildly different reactions with other gases."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A highly toxic gas and difficult to produce gas. It breaks down when in contact with Nitrogen, making it relatively safe in Earth-like atmospheres."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A potent fire suppressant. It removes Oxygen from high temperature fires and cools down the area."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"An inert noble gas produced by the fusion of Hydrogen and its derivatives. Commonly known for being lighter than air and its ability to raise voice pitch when inhaled."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A mysterious and highly reactive gas known to replicate itself. It is highly sought after due to its rarity, and will export for a high price."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Perform a routine patrol of %AREA_NAME%. You must travel at least %AREA_COVERAGE% meters within the area. Your ID card will update you as you progress."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Blood cells suspended in plasma, the most abundant of which being the hemoglobin-containing red blood cells."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Allows for departments to order supplied from Cargo for free, with a cooldown between orders."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Something seems to have gone wrong with this alert, so report this bug please"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"You\u0027re not getting enough oxygen. Find some good air before you pass out! The box in your backpack has an oxygen tank and breath mask in it."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"There\u0027s too much oxygen in the air, and you\u0027re breathing it in! Find some good air before you pass out!"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"You\u0027re not getting enough nitrogen. Find some good air before you pass out!"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"There\u0027s too much nitrogen in the air, and you\u0027re breathing it in! Find some good air before you pass out!"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"You\u0027re not getting enough carbon dioxide. Find some good air before you pass out!"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"There\u0027s too much carbon dioxide in the air, and you\u0027re breathing it in! Find some good air before you pass out!"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"You\u0027re not getting enough plasma. Find some good air before you pass out! The box in your backpack has a spare plasma tank."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"There\u0027s highly flammable, toxic plasma in the air and you\u0027re breathing it in. Find some fresh air. The box in your backpack has an oxygen tank and breath mask in it."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"You\u0027re not getting enough N2O. Find some good air before you pass out!"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"There\u0027s sleeping gas in the air and you\u0027re breathing it in. Find some fresh air. The box in your backpack has an oxygen tank and breath mask in it."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"You\u0027re getting pulled upwards. While you won\u0027t have to worry about falling down anymore, you may accidentally fall upwards!"}

{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Gravity has ceased affecting you, and you\u0027re floating around aimlessly. You\u0027ll need something large and heavy, like a wall or lattice, to push yourself off if you want to move. A jetpack would enable free range of motion. A pair of magboots would let you walk around normally on the floor. Barring those, you can throw things, use a fire extinguisher, or shoot a gun to move around via Newton\u0027s 3rd Law of Motion."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"You\u0027re getting crushed by high gravity, picking up items and movement will be slowed."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"You\u0027re getting crushed by high gravity, picking up items and movement will be slowed. You\u0027ll also accumulate brute damage!"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A maintenance drone, an expendable robot built to perform station repairs."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A little cleaning robot, he looks so excited!"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"You are a cleanbot! Clean the station to the best of your ability!"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A little security robot. He looks less than thrilled."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"You are a securitron! Guard the station to the best of your ability!"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A little medical robot. He looks somewhat underwhelmed."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"You are a medbot! Ensure good health among the crew to the best of your ability!"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"You are a MULEbot! Do your best to make sure that packages get to their destination!"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A mysterious being that stands by its charge, ever vigilant."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A standard issue colored jumpsuit. Variety is the spice of life!"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A tasteful grey jumpskirt that reminds you of the good old days."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A tasteful grey jumpsuit that reminds you of the good old days."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A terribly ragged and frayed grey jumpsuit. It looks like it hasn\u0027t been washed in over a decade."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Don\u0027t wear this near paranoid security officers."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Just looking at this makes you feel \u003Ci\u003Efabulous\u003C/i\u003E."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A disk containing source code. It can be used to preload items into the virtual domain."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Range isn\u0027t an issue when you can bring your victim to you."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A three-round burst .223 toploading carbine, designated \u0027M-90gl\u0027. Has an attached underbarrel grenade launcher."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A small electronic device that should never exist."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A delicious lollipop. Makes for a great Valentine\u0027s present."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Automatically activates upon implantation. Provides radio transmission and reception capabilities."}

{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"The Internal Radio Implant, a long open-sourced design manufactured by just about everyone from Nanotrasen to Cybersun, is a subdermal two-way radio system designed to interface with telecommunications networks. It\u0027s mainly useful for those who expect either equipment loss or lack the ability to use standalone radio equipment easily."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A metal gauntlet with a piston-powered ram on top for that extra \u0027oomph\u0027 in your punch."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A card used to provide ID and determine access across the station."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Didn\u0027t make sense not to live for fun, your brain gets smart but your head gets dumb."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"This item shouldn\u0027t exist. Talk about breaking a leg. Badum-Tss!"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Some athletes prefer to tie their left shoelaces first for good luck. In this instance, it probably would not have helped."}

{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"You put your right leg in, your right leg out. In, out, in, out, shake it all about. And apparently then it detaches.\nThe hokey pokey has certainly changed a lot since space colonisation."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"It\u0027s impolite to stare at a person\u0027s chest."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Hey buddy give me a HAND and report this to the github because you shouldn\u0027t be seeing this."}

{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Did you know that the word \u0027sinister\u0027 stems originally from the Latin \u0027sinestra\u0027 (left hand), because the left hand was supposed to be possessed by the devil? This arm appears to be possessed by no one though."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Over 87% of humans are right handed. That figure is much lower among humans missing their right arm."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A module using chameleon technology to disguise the suit as another object."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A copy of some top-secret documents. Nobody will notice they aren\u0027t the originals... right?"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A device that delivers powerful shocks to detachable paddles that resuscitate incapacitated patients. Has a rear bracket for attachments to wall mounts and medical cyborgs."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A wicked payload meant to wildly transmutate terrain over a wide area, a power no mere human should wield."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"has decayed for too long, and has turned a sickly color. It probably won\u0027t work without repairs."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"your face freezing and an icicle forming"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"your face burning and a searing heat"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027warning\u0027\u003EYou feel some sort of constriction around your chest as your breathing becomes shallow and rapid.\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027warning\u0027\u003EYour lungs seem to once again be able to hold air.\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027info\u0027\u003EThe constriction around your chest loosens as your breathing calms down.\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A pair of lungs that look sickly, a result from smoking a lot."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A fleshy muscle mostly used for lying."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A piece of juicy meat found in a person\u0027s head."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"I feel bad for the heartless bastard who lost this."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027info\u0027\u003EPrickles of pain appear then die out from within your chest...\u003C/span\u003E"}

{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027warning\u0027\u003ESomething inside your chest hurts, and the pain isn\u0027t subsiding. You notice yourself breathing far faster than before.\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027info\u0027\u003EYour heart begins to beat again.\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027info\u0027\u003EThe pain in your chest has died down, and your breathing becomes more relaxed.\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027info\u0027\u003EYour stomach flashes with pain before subsiding. Food doesn\u0027t seem like a good idea right now.\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027warning\u0027\u003EYour stomach flares up with constant pain- you can hardly stomach the idea of food right now!\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027info\u0027\u003EThe pain in your stomach dies down for now, but food still seems unappealing.\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027info\u0027\u003EThe last bouts of pain in your stomach have died out.\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A crystal-like organ that stores the electric charge of ethereals."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027info\u0027\u003EDistant objects become somewhat less tangible.\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027info\u0027\u003EEverything starts to look a lot less clear.\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027warning\u0027\u003EDarkness envelopes you, as your eyes go blind!\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027info\u0027\u003EColor and shapes are once again perceivable.\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027info\u0027\u003EYour vision functions passably once more.\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027info\u0027\u003EYour vision is cleared of any ailment.\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027warning\u0027\u003EAn explosion of pain erupts in your lower right abdomen!\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027info\u0027\u003EThe pain in your abdomen has subsided.\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"There are three parts to the ear. Inner, middle and outer. Only one of these parts should be normally visible."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027info\u0027\u003EYour ears begin to resonate with an internal ring sometimes.\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027warning\u0027\u003EYou are unable to hear at all!\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027info\u0027\u003ENoise slowly begins filling your ears once more.\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"\u003Cspan class=\u0027info\u0027\u003EThe ringing in your ears has died down.\u003C/span\u003E"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A shield with a built in, high intensity light capable of blinding and disorienting suspects. Takes regular handheld flashes as bulbs."}

{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"An ingenious little device manufactured for supporting an alternative method for respiration. Relying on a removable cell, the coil mechanism synthesizes a hydrogen oxygen mixture, which can then be used to moisturize the wearer's gills. 
The rate at which liquid is applied seems to be intended for skin which excells at retaining moisture. 
There is a picture of planet Marina stamped onto it. 

A label on its back warns about the potential dangers of electro-magnetic pulses."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A basic handheld radio that communicates with local telecommunication networks."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A device used to rapidly deploy plastic decorative flora. Internally synthesizes cheap plastic replicas of natural scenery."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"An expertly modified RCD outfitted to construct plumbing machinery."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A complex metal backbone with standard limb sockets and pseudomuscle anchors."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"These seeds grow into replica pods. They say these are used to harvest humans."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"It doesn\u0027t matter if you didn\u0027t want it before, what matters now is that you\u0027ve got a coupon for it!"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A carefully cut graft off of a freshly grown plant. Can be grafted onto a plant in order to share unique plant traits onto a plant."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A large plastic bag containing commercial garden soil. It is packed with sand, peat and manure. While you might not care much for such mixture, the plants have strange tastes."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Pure processing potential packed into a puny but powerful pundit."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"The massive external power source for the laser gatling gun."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A control terminal for the area\u0027s electrical systems."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Generates gravity around itself. Powered by wire or cell. Must be anchored before use."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"An automated announcement system that handles minor announcements over the radio."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A machine used to deposit and withdraw station funds."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Used to control a linked teleportation Hub and Station."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Used to send criminals to the Labor Camp."}

{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"This console allows the user to purchase a package with 1/40th of the delivery time: made possible by Nanotrasen\u0027s new \u00221500mm Orbital Railgun\u0022.All sales are near instantaneous - please choose carefully"}

{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Allows a deployable expedition base to be dropped from the station to a designated mining location. It can also interface with the mining shuttle at the landing site if a mobile beacon is also deployed."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A device used to perform \u0022enhanced interrogation\u0022 through invasive mental conditioning."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"This device recharges energy-dependent lifeforms, like cyborgs, ethereals, and MODsuit users."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A console intended to send requests to different departments on the station."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A large and menacing device. Can be bolted down with a wrench."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A screen that displays the vitals of a patient."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"This is the Hypertorus Fusion Reactor core, an advanced piece of technology to finely tune the reaction inside of the machine. It has I/O for cooling gases."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A button used for the explicit purpose of opening an airlock."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A small console that can cycle opening between two airlocks."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"An all-in-one bluespace storage and transmission system for the station\u0027s mineral distribution needs."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A portable electrolyzer, allowing for on-site production of Hydrogen. Warranty void if used by clowns."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Just like the old days. Smokes items over a light heat"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A robot-only gate into the wonders of Space Station cuisine!"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A basin used to grow plants in."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A press that makes pills, patches and bottles."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Used to separate chemicals and distribute them in a variety of forms."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"I guess we figured out what happened to the guy who lives here. You\u0027d best tread lightly around this..."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A board filled with colored dots. What could this mean?"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Activates pod doors if activated with a puzzle signal."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A man-sized yellow egg, spawned from some unfathomable creature. A humanoid silhouette lurks within."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"You are an ash walker. Your tribe worships the Necropolis."}

{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"The wastes are sacred ground, its monsters a blessed bounty. You have seen lights in the distance... they foreshadow the arrival of outsiders that seek to tear apart the Necropolis and its domain. Fresh sacrifices for your nest."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A crate designed for safe transport of animals. It has an oxygen tank for safe transport in space."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Mycena Bregprox, a species of mushroom that glows in the dark."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A wall of solid light, likely defending something important. Virtually indestructible, must be a way around, or to disable it."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"When you really want to send a message."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Used to indicate a place to sit for a robot tourist. I better be careful."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"Effectively impervious to conventional methods of destruction."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"It looks like base turfs went to the fucking moon, TELL YOUR LOCAL CODER TODAY"}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"The floor you walk on. It looks near-impervious to damage."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A tiled floor made out of an odd pale stone."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A tiled floor made out of an odd pale stone, inscribed with odd runes."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"A floor made of invulnerable notebook paper."}
{"K":"str","N":0,"S":"The attachment points are all bent to uselessness, looks nigh-impervious to damage."}
